select DOCUMENT_ID, NYS_ID, LABID, LABNO, LINK, MEDRECNO, INFANT_FNAME, INFANT_LNAME, AKA, TO_CHAR(BIRTH_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') BIRTH_DATE, BIRTH_TIME, BIRTH_WEIGHT, RACE_WHITE, RACE_BLACK, RACE_ASIAN, RACE_OTHER, RACE_INDIAN, ETHNICITY, SEX, MOTHER_FNAME, MOTHER_LNAME, MOTHER_AGE, TO_CHAR(MOTHER_DOB, 'MM/DD/YYYY') MOTHER_DOB, MOTHER_ADDRESS, MOTHER_CITY, MOTHER_STATE, MOTHER_ZIP, MOTHER_COUNTY, MOTHER_REGION, MOTHER_PHONE, MOTHER_LATITUDE, MOTHER_LONGITUDE, MOTHER_CENSUS_TRACT, TO_CHAR(COLLECTION_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') COLLECTION_DATE, TO_CHAR(DATE_RECEIVED, 'MM/DD/YYYY') DATE_RECEIVED, TO_CHAR(DATE_REPORTED, 'MM/DD/YYYY') DATE_REPORTED, INIT_RPT, BIRTH_HOSPITAL_CODE, PFI, FACILITY_NAME, FACILITY_ADDRESS, FACILITY_CITY, FACILITY_STATE, FACILITY_ZIP, FACILITY_COUNTY, FACILITY_REGION, FACILITY_LATITUDE, FACILITY_LONGITUDE, FACILITY_CENSUS_TRACT, TWIN_STATUS, HIV_FINAL_STATUS, TRANS_CALC_KEEP, CLIMS_RECID, PATIENTID, MEMO, CLIMS_MATCH_UID, CLIMS_MATCH_DT, CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS, INFANT_STATENO, MOTHER_STATENO, POT_MOTHER_STATENO, FACILITY_PHONE, FACILITY_EHARS_UID from std_nbs_doc where document_id = #{docId}

SELECT document_id, TRIM (labid) labid, TRIM (labno) labno, TRIM (link) link, TRIM (medrecno) medrecno, TRIM (fname) infant_fname, TRIM (lname) infant_lname, TRIM (aka) aka, fn_to_char (TRIM (birthdt), 'MM/DD/YYYY') BIRTH_DATE, TRIM (birthtm) BIRTH_TIME, TRIM (birthwt) BIRTH_WEIGHT, CASE WHEN TRIM (race) = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END race_white, CASE WHEN TRIM (race) = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END race_black, CASE WHEN TRIM (race) = '4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END race_asian, CASE WHEN TRIM (race) = '5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END race_other, CASE WHEN TRIM (race) = '6' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END race_indian, CASE WHEN TRIM (race) = '3' THEN '01' ELSE NULL END ethnicity, case when TRIM (sex) = '1' then 'M' when TRIM (sex) = '2' then 'F' else null end sex, TRIM (mfname) mother_fname, TRIM (mlname) mother_lname, TRIM (motherage) mother_age, fn_to_char (TRIM (motherdob), 'MM/DD/YYYY') mother_dob, TRIM (street) mother_address, TRIM (r.city) mother_city, TRIM (r.state) mother_state, TRIM (r.zipcode) mother_zip, n.county_fips_cd mother_county -- Check if Lpad is required , CASE WHEN n.county_fips_cd IN ('005', '047', '061', '081', '085') THEN 'NYC' WHEN TRIM (r.state) = 'NY' AND n.county_fips_cd NOT IN ('005', '047', '061', '081', '085') THEN 'NYS' ELSE 'OOS' END MOTHER_REGION, TRIM (phone) mother_phone, fn_to_char (TRIM (dtcoll), 'MM/DD/YYYY') collection_date, fn_to_char (TRIM (dtrecv), 'MM/DD/YYYY') date_received, fn_to_char (TRIM (dtrptd), 'MM/DD/YYYY') date_reported, TRIM (init_rpt) init_rpt, TRIM (birthhosp) birthhosp, TRIM (r.pfi) pfi, TRIM (p.name) facility_name, TRIM (p.address) facility_address, TRIM (p.city) facility_city, NULL facility_state, TRIM (p.zipcode) facility_zip, TRIM (p.county_cd) facility_county, CASE WHEN n1.county_fips_cd IN ('005', '047', '061', '081', '085') THEN 'NYC' WHEN TRIM (p.state) = 'NY' AND n1.county_fips_cd NOT IN ('005', '047', '061', '081', '085') THEN 'NYS' ELSE 'OOS' END facility_region, TRIM (twin) twin_status, CASE WHEN TRIM (twin) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN TRIM (twin) IN ('0', '1') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'NT' END trans_calc_keep, clims_recid, patientid, memo, clims_match_dt FROM raw_nbs_doc r LEFT OUTER JOIN coded_nbs_pfi_names p ON (TRIM (r.pfi) = LPAD (p.pfi, 6, '0')) LEFT OUTER JOIN nyehms_county_reference n ON ( TRIM (r.zipcode) = n.zip_cd AND TRIM (r.state) = n.state_cd AND n.num_city = 1) LEFT OUTER JOIN nyehms_county_reference n1 ON ( TRIM (p.zipcode) = n1.zip_cd AND TRIM (p.state) = n1.state_cd AND n1.num_city = 1) WHERE document_id = #{docId}

WITH clims AS ( SELECT Distinct pkg_consolidation.fn_give_current_stateno(matched_stateno) infant_stateno, patientId, colldate FROM std_clims_doc WHERE pkg_consolidation.fn_give_current_stateno(matched_stateno) = PKG_CONSOLIDATION.FN_GIVE_CURRENT_STATENO (#{stateno}) AND patientid IS NOT NULL ), final_clims AS ( SELECT patientId, colldate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY infant_stateno ORDER BY colldate desc ) rn FROM clims ) SELECT patientId FROM final_clims WHERE rn = 1

select DOCUMENT_ID, LABID, LABNO, FNAME, LNAME, MEDRECNO, to_char(BIRTHDT, 'MM/DD/YYYY') DATE_OF_BIRTH, case when SEX = '1' then 'Male' when SEX = '2' then 'Female' end GENDER, BIRTHWT WEIGHT, PFI, ZIPCODE from raw_nbs_doc
where PATIENTID is null
AND UPPER(LABID) LIKE trim(UPPER(#{p_labId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}))
AND UPPER(FNAME) LIKE trim(UPPER(#{p_firstName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}))
AND UPPER(LNAME) LIKE trim(UPPER(#{p_lastName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}))
AND UPPER(LABNO) LIKE trim(UPPER(#{p_labNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) )
AND UPPER(MEDRECNO) LIKE trim(UPPER(#{p_medRecordNumber,jdbcType=VARCHAR}))
AND to_char(BIRTHDT, 'MM/DD/YYYY') LIKE #{p_dateOfBirth,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND BIRTHWT = #{p_weight,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND SEX = trim(#{p_gender,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
AND PFI LIKE UPPER(#{p_pfi,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
